picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: Rising unemployment would signal labor-market cooling, shaping Federal Reserve rate decisions and household income prospects heading into 2027.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.5% in Q4 2026?
picks.why: Fourth-quarter growth above 1.5 percent would show the economy expanding despite tariffs, elevated inflation, and policy uncertainty.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test whether taxing extreme wealth raises revenue or prompts capital and residents to leave.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Much of the world's oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs, and inflation elevated.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which firm leads frontier AI shapes where investment, market power, and productivity gains concentrate in the technology sector.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a famous unsolved math problem would signal capabilities that could transform research productivity across science.
